publication_note: Core: 26 public scenarios across JMeter, k6, Locust and Gatling (104 tasks). Models use the same Core efficiency budgets, one repair round for eligible pre-grading load/run failures, and a 65,536-token output cap; DeepSeek reasoning mode is thinking-high. Scores are the final answer after the one allowed repair. Costs are estimates from reported token usage at frozen registry prices, not provider invoices.
